about: Guides & Tools: one list for the public page (/guides.html) and the Client Hub copy (/hub/guides.html). Rendered by /assets/guides-tools.js. After editing, run: node scripts/build-guides-tools.js (it rewrites the cards in guides.html; --check fails if they differ). tier: lead (the larger featured card that leads the library; one per listing), tile (a live card), soon (the Coming soon row, never a link). members: true shows only in the Client Hub, in the Members band (live or soon). art: the card's illustration (lines, bars, rings, lab, fan, house, steps).
